name: workshop-synthesis
description: Workshop synthesis recipes for Claude Code: turn workshop outputs into decisions using the four-moves framework (cluster, interpret, prioritize, narrate). 8 skills, 7 slash commands, 26 prompts. Companion plugin to Bill Bulman's book The Synthesis Playbook (Workshopr facilitation series, Book 6). Platform-neutral by design — the underlying prompts in prompts/ work in any LLM.
